name: Chariot
description: Manage your nonprofit's gift processing directly from Claude. Connect your Chariot account to look up, create, and reconcile donations, process checks received by mail, and edit donation details. Manage the custom properties and policies that automate your donation pipeline, read deposits, ledger transactions, and invoices, and export your data for reporting. Built for nonprofits and their finance teams, Chariot brings your entire donation workflow—records, deposits, reconciliation, and reporting—into your conversation, with secure OAuth access scoped to exactly the data and actions you authorize.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Chariot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Chariot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.givechariot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Chariot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Chariot lists 65 MCP tools, including add_policy_clause, add_policy_section, assign_property, bulk_create_enum_options, count_donations, create_asset_upload_url, create_donation, create_enum_option, create_export, create_filter_view, create_payment_source, and create_property.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Chariot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Chariot in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Benevity, Candid, and Givebutter.
Chariot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Chariot is developed by Chariot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
